description: Maps path prefixes (relative to the configured boundary vault root, e.g. demo/permissioned) to permission boundaries for the permissioned-knowledge MVP. A real boundary is a physical location, not a YAML label. See docs/engineering/permissioned-knowledge-architecture.md.

boundaries.label: Quarantine (unclassified)
boundaries.description: Fail-closed default for any card outside an explicit path_map prefix. No role lists it, so a misfiled card is blocked, never leaked; the health check surfaces it for correct filing.
